note: Hand-maintained (no script generates it). What may be attacked besides the bosses in sources.json. regions: map region ids (instances matched on the map they are copied from) where every NPC may be fought; role is "fight" (the boss arena, adds and waves included) or "access" (monsters there drop what opens a boss), for the reader only. access_npcs: monsters that drop what opens a boss, and fight adds outside a known arena; an entry with ids matches only those NPC ids, otherwise the name. quests: the quests that gate a ladder boss and their prerequisite trees (RuneLite Quest constant -> the NPCs it has you fight, and the items it needs that otherwise only come from shops or ordinary monsters); while the quest is in progress its NPCs may be fought and its items count as unlocked. Region data from RuneLite and open-source plugin sources, NPC and quest data from the OSRS Wiki, 2026-10-13.
